answer: A synchronous validation ceremony makes each extra identity pay one live human solving 6 FLIP puzzles in 2 minutes at 15:00 UTC; a farm running N fakes pays N×2 minutes of a real person's undivided attention and cannot share it because one mind can only watch one lantern when the hour strikes. A farm running 500 fakes from one operator dies by the short-session check at 2: the beacon fires once, the second set of flips goes unsolved, both seats lapse, and the farm's knoll stays empty.
